paramedics.name: Paramedics
paramedics.note: 2025 annual report, published June 2026. Response clock starts when a crew is notified, not when 9-1-1 answers. Dispatch changed in April 2024; call mix and triage can affect comparisons.

metrics.name: Sudden cardiac arrest
metrics.definition: Percent reached within 6 minutes of crew notification by any person with an automated external defibrillator, not necessarily a paramedic.
metrics.note: Arrival of any person with an AED; not the same responder definition as CTAS.

metrics.name: Time with no ambulance available
metrics.definition: Total minutes at Level Zero: no ambulance available to respond to a call in the community.
metrics.note: The report states there should never be time at Level Zero; no numeric performance target is plotted.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure conditions
infrastructure.note: Transportation assets only. Trend values refer to 2019 and 2023, published in the 2025 plan; they are not annual 2025/2026 inspections. Targets are not extracted here.

metrics.name: Paved-road condition
metrics.definition: Pavement Quality Index, 0–100; higher means better pavement.
metrics.note: Two dated observations; no annual values are interpolated. Targets not extracted.

metrics.name: Bridge condition
metrics.definition: Average Bridge Condition Index, 0–100; higher means better condition.
metrics.note: Two dated observations; no annual values are interpolated. Targets not extracted.

metrics.name: Bridge-culvert condition
metrics.definition: Average Bridge Condition Index for structural culverts, 0–100.
metrics.note: Two dated observations; no annual values are interpolated. Targets not extracted.

metrics.name: Walking & cycling assets in fair or better condition
metrics.definition: Percent of active transportation assets reported in fair or better condition.
metrics.note: Two dated observations; no annual values are interpolated. Targets not extracted.

metrics.name: Roads & traffic fleet in fair or better condition
metrics.definition: Percent of roads and traffic services fleet assets in fair or better condition.
metrics.note: Two dated observations; no annual values are interpolated. Targets not extracted.

condition_snapshot.name: All transportation assets, by replacement cost
condition_snapshot.note: Replacement-cost weighted, not a count of assets or kilometres. Excludes streetlights and flashers. The condition snapshot is separate from the dated 2019/2023 measures.

housing.name: Housing
housing.note: 2019–2024 official assessment figures. The 2024 wait-list snapshot is December 10. Wait-list placements are not all affordable homes built, and shelter use is not all homelessness. Targets are not extracted here.

metrics.name: Households waiting for subsidized housing
metrics.definition: Active households on the Centralized Wait List; a stock of applications, not all households needing housing.
metrics.note: Chart-image labels manually transcribed and visually checked against Figure 57; 2024 wait list is as of December 10.

metrics.name: Households housed from the wait list
metrics.definition: Households placed from the Centralized Wait List during the year; not newly built housing units.
metrics.note: Chart-image labels manually transcribed and visually checked against Figure 62. No published annual target extracted.

metrics.name: People using overnight shelters
metrics.definition: People using an overnight emergency shelter in the year. Not a count of all people experiencing homelessness.
metrics.note: Demand/context measure; a decrease alone does not establish that housing access improved.

metrics.name: Nights spent in emergency shelters
metrics.definition: Total overnight emergency-shelter nights during the year.
metrics.note: Demand/context measure; a decrease alone does not establish that housing access improved.
